name: Senga Sally
source:
Seira's mother.

Sally was born and raised in Japan, but perhaps because her roots are in the eight great dragon kings of India, she has an exotic appearance that is reminiscent of her Japanese ancestors. She is somewhat reserved for the fierce human-dragon tribe.

According to the family's law, Sally has been married off since she was born. Being married regardless of her wishes, and she is ignorant of sexual matters. Perhaps because of her repressed life, she has an unusual longing for forbidden love. After being chosen as a candidate for Holic Milk, Sally confesses her secret feelings to Taichi.
